nodes.label: Tomato Plant Photo (Tomat)
nodes.description: Photograph of a tomato plant (Solanum lycopersicum). Pinnately compound leaves with serrated/toothed leaflet margins and slightly pubescent surface confirm tomato identification. Plant shows moderate health in early warning stage: leaf edge browning, minor irregular spotting consistent with early fungal infection, slight leaf curl possibly from heat/water stress or early viral infection, and uneven green coloration suggesting nutrient stress.

edges.note: Tomat plant photo is displayed as a selection card on the home/plant selection screen
Tomat plant photo is the subject plant whose disease detection result is displayed in tomato_detect screen
Tomat photo relates to the disease detection app workflow documented in Panduan
